# Darb (درب), Jordan trips, reality-checked

> Darb checks a Jordan itinerary day by day against local transport data and fixes it: paste a plan (or build one), get a Reality Score out of 100, each day marked OK / Risky / Not feasible with the reason, a fix and the cost in JOD, then a corrected plan with every transport leg costed. Rule-based (no AI), built by team PixelsDev on Firebase.

Honesty rule: only values marked "verified" carry a check mark and a verified date; everything else is an estimate ("est.") shown as a range. Verified values older than 90 days are shown as estimates.

## Pages
- [Check my plan](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/plan): paste an itinerary, choose airports, month, car.
- [Build a plan](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/build): pick interests; only reachable places are suggested.
- [Destinations](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/destinations): the 12 covered places with transport answers and prices.
  - [Amman](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/amman)
  - [Jerash](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/jerash)
  - [Ajloun](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/ajloun)
  - [Umm Qais](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/umm-qais)
  - [As-Salt](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/as-salt)
  - [Dead Sea](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/dead-sea)
  - [Madaba & Mount Nebo](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/madaba)
  - [Petra](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/petra)
  - [Wadi Rum](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/wadi-rum)
  - [Aqaba](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/aqaba)
  - [Dana Biosphere Reserve](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/dana)
  - [Kerak Castle](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/d/kerak)
- [Dashboard](https://darb-pixelsdev.web.app/dashboard): anonymous aggregate of checked plans (demo figures are labelled demo data).

## Verified facts
- JETT bus Abdali (Amman) → Wadi Musa (Petra): departs 06:30, 10 JOD (checked 24 Sep 2026 in JETT's booking system). The return timetable is not verified.
- Licensed minibus fares (LTRC list, checked 30 Sep 2026): Amman North station → Jerash 1.10 JOD; Amman South station → Madaba 0.60 JOD; Amman South station → Kerak 2.30 JOD; Amman Muhajireen station → Dead Sea rest house 0.95 JOD. No published timetables, they leave when full.
- Airport Express bus Queen Alia Airport → Amman: 3.4 JOD (Sariyah, checked 30 Sep 2026).
- Petra entry: 50 JOD (1 day), 55 JOD (2 days), 60 JOD (3 days); 90 JOD for same-day visitors with no overnight stay (visitpetra.jo, checked 30 Sep 2026).
- Entry fees from the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities fee table (checked 30 Sep 2026): Jerash 10 JOD, Wadi Rum protected area 5 JOD, Umm Qais 5 JOD, Amman Citadel 3 JOD, Ajloun Castle 3 JOD, Madaba Archaeological Park 3 JOD, Kerak Castle 2 JOD.
- Dana Biosphere Reserve 8 JOD + 16% sales tax for non-Jordanian visitors (≈ 9.3 JOD), verified 30 Sep 2026 (mota.gov.jo).
- Jordan Pass: Wanderer 70, Explorer 75, Expert 80 JOD (by Petra days); the 40 JOD visa fee is waived only if the Pass is bought before arrival and the stay is at least 2 whole nights (3 days) (jordanpass.jo, checked 30 Sep 2026).
- Wadi Rum was not a bookable destination in JETT's booking system (checked 24 Sep 2026); from Petra, plan a pre-arranged transfer (est. 35–45 JOD).

## Covered places
Amman, Jerash, Ajloun, Umm Qais, As-Salt, Dead Sea, Madaba & Mount Nebo, Petra, Wadi Rum, Aqaba, Dana, Kerak. Not covered yet: Desert Castles, Azraq, Wadi Mujib, Little Petra, Feynan, Shobak, Baptism Site, Irbid, Ma'in.
